hero.title: Radiant Waves Media Morning Global News
hero.description: Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Good morning. Here are today's leading breaking stories, world news, Europe, Africa, business, markets, technology and climate developments from around the world.

featured.imageQuery: Colombia 7.4 earthquake rescue operation collapsed buildings 2026
featured.title: Colombia Hit By Powerful 7.4-Magnitude Earthquake
featured.content: A powerful magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia, causing major damage and triggering a large rescue operation. Reports say the death toll has reached 132, with more than 570 people injured. Rescue teams continue searching damaged buildings for survivors.

articles.imageQuery: Colombia earthquake rescue workers collapsed buildings
articles.title: 🇨🇴 Colombia Earthquake Death Toll Rises To 132
articles.description: A powerful magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia, killing at least 132 people and injuring more than 570. Rescue operations continue as authorities search damaged buildings and assess the scale of destruction.

articles.imageQuery: Nizhnekamsk Russia drone attack damaged building 2026
articles.title: 🇷🇺 Deadly Drone Attack Reported In Russia
articles.description: A Ukrainian drone strike in Nizhnekamsk, Tatarstan, reportedly killed 13 people, including a child, according to Russian authorities. The attack adds to continuing tensions in the Russia-Ukraine war.

articles.imageQuery: Iran Tehran Middle East security diplomacy
articles.title: 🇮🇷 Iran Remains Under International Scrutiny
articles.description: Iran's political and security situation remains a major international concern following the recent conflict. Governments continue watching developments involving Iran's relationship with the United States and wider regional security.

articles.imageQuery: Middle East diplomacy international security meeting
articles.title: 🌍 Middle East Tensions Remain High
articles.description: International attention remains focused on security developments in the Middle East as governments seek to prevent further escalation and protect regional stability and critical shipping routes.

articles.imageQuery: Europe heatwave drought dry river wildfire France 2026
articles.title: 🔥 Europe Braces For Another Major Heatwave
articles.description: Another period of extreme heat is approaching parts of Europe. Rivers are running exceptionally low and drought conditions are worsening, while authorities continue imposing water-use restrictions in several countries.

articles.imageQuery: total solar eclipse Spain August 12 2026
articles.title: 🌑 Total Solar Eclipse Coming Tomorrow
articles.description: Skywatchers are preparing for the August 12 total solar eclipse. NASA says the path of totality will cross Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic Ocean, Spain and a small part of Portugal. Much of Europe and northwestern Africa will experience a partial eclipse.

articles.imageQuery: solar eclipse Spain Portugal August 2026
articles.title: 🌑 Europe Prepares For A Spectacular Eclipse
articles.description: Spain is expected to experience one of the most dramatic views of the eclipse, while other European countries will see varying levels of partial coverage. The event is expected to attract large crowds of skywatchers.

articles.title: 🇳🇬 Cost-Of-Living Pressure Remains A Major Concern In Nigeria
articles.description: Rising living costs continue affecting Nigerian households and businesses. Consumers remain under pressure as food, transportation and other essential expenses continue shaping economic discussions.

articles.imageQuery: Nigerian naira currency Nigeria economy
articles.title: 💱 Naira Remains In Focus
articles.description: The Nigerian currency remains closely watched as businesses and consumers monitor exchange-rate movements and their impact on prices, imports and household purchasing power.

articles.imageQuery: Nigeria football NFF election football stadium
articles.title: ⚽ NFF Election Debate Intensifies
articles.description: Nigerian football stakeholders remain divided over calls concerning the upcoming NFF elections, with debate continuing over football administration and recent World Cup qualification setbacks.

articles.imageQuery: oil prices stock market trading screens global markets
articles.title: 🛢️ Oil Prices Remain Elevated
articles.description: Oil prices are holding near higher levels following a sharp jump as investors assess geopolitical developments and potential risks to global energy supplies. Asian stock markets remain mixed.

articles.imageQuery: global stock market investors trading screens
articles.title: 📈 Global Markets Watch Geopolitical Risks
articles.description: Investors continue monitoring inflation, interest rates, energy prices and geopolitical developments as they assess the outlook for the global economy.

articles.imageQuery: global energy market oil shipping Middle East
articles.title: 🌍 Energy Markets Remain Sensitive To Geopolitical Tensions
articles.description: International energy markets remain sensitive to developments in the Middle East and Russia-Ukraine war as traders assess possible disruptions to oil supplies and shipping routes.

articles.title: 🚀 Vietnam's VinSpace Signs SpaceX Launch Deal
articles.description: Vietnamese aerospace company VinSpace has signed an agreement with SpaceX to launch its first satellites in 2027, highlighting Vietnam's growing ambitions in the space and satellite industry.

articles.title: 🤖 AI Investment Continues To Surge
articles.description: Nvidia says it has partnered with major financial institutions on financing platforms designed to support massive investment in artificial-intelligence infrastructure, highlighting the enormous capital demands of the AI boom.

articles.imageQuery: artificial intelligence data center technology computers
articles.title: 💻 Global AI Race Accelerates
articles.description: Artificial intelligence continues to reshape technology and business as companies invest heavily in computing infrastructure, advanced chips and new AI systems while governments debate safety and regulation.

articles.title: 🇺🇸 US Economy Remains In Focus
articles.description: Investors continue watching inflation, interest rates, energy prices and geopolitical developments for signals about the direction of the US and global economy.

articles.title: 🌡️ Extreme Weather Raises Global Climate Concerns
articles.description: Heatwaves, drought and wildfire risks continue affecting communities across several regions, increasing pressure on governments and emergency services to strengthen preparedness.

articles.title: 🤝 International Diplomacy Remains Critical
articles.description: Governments and international organizations continue diplomatic efforts focused on conflicts, humanitarian assistance, security, migration and economic stability.
